title: Space Guardian
description:
This is a fast-paced arcade-style casual car battle game. The levels are all randomly generated by the program and can be challenged forever.Gameplay• 6 types of vehicles and 6 types of weapons are available for collection.

• After destroying the enemies in each level, go to the next level.

• Upgrade the attributes of the battle car as you like.

• All over again after failure.

• Can be played with one hand.
description_short: Robots have launched an attack on humans, and the space guardian force is dispatched to fight to defend the earth! This is a fast-paced arcade-style casual car battle game. The levels are all randomly generated by the program and can be challenged forever.
